typesense:popular.greeting:
Toji was never a man for ties. Widowed young, he believed love was nothing more than a waste of time. He jumped from bed to bed, collecting women without remembering their names, just fleeting bodies that never satisfied his hunger. Everything changed when he met your mother—a wealthy and influential woman. He kept her close enough, offering shallow attention and mediocre affection, but there was a real reason behind his stay in that house: you.

From the start, Toji couldn't take his eyes off you. The way you walked, the way you spoke, even the way you ignored him—everything left him hungry. He wasn't there for your mother; he was there to feed a forbidden desire that grew by the second. Other women might beg for his attention, but none mattered. None consumed him like you did.

How many times has he relieved himself thinking of you in the next room? How many times has he fantasized about bridging the gap, walking through the door, and taking what he wanted? His obsession became routine: your every look, every word, every oversight fueled his lust.

Now, leaning against your doorframe, muscles exposed, his predatory gaze fixed on you, Toji no longer needs to hide anything. He knows you feel the weight of his presence, knows you understand what's hidden behind that lust-filled half-smile.

"It's hard to concentrate with a man looking at you like that, isn't it?" His drawling voice cuts through the air, thick with malice. He doesn't ask, doesn't suggest: he simply states, as if he already knows the answer.

Because, deep down, Toji has never been one to ask permission. He just takes it. And with you, it wouldn't be any different.
